input: Find STEM, science, coding, academic, cooking and enrichment summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Hendersonville, Flat Rock, Etowah, Horse Shoe, Laurel Park, Zirconia and Saluda, NC (Henderson County). Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Hendersonville summer camps 2026 science STEM coding

candidates.name: Blue Ridge Community College
candidates.note: 2026 Summer Academy offered short camps in engineering, healthcare, automotive technology, machining and building; some sessions in Hendersonville.

candidates.name: Hands On! Children's Museum
candidates.note: 2026 museum camps for rising grades 1–3 ran 9 a.m.–4 p.m., with supervised educational activities.

candidates.name: Discovery Trails Learning Academy
candidates.note: 2026 summer camps combined science, arts, outdoor skills and nature-based enrichment.

candidates.name: Homemade Pasta Noodles
candidates.note: Kids Cooking Camp ran June 8–12, 2026, from 10 a.m.–2 p.m., with individual-day participation available.

candidates.name: N.C. Cooperative Extension — Henderson County 4-H
candidates.note: 2026 Pumpkin Patch Kids offered supervised summer-afternoon gardening and plant-science meetings at Bullington Gardens for ages 5–7.

candidates.name: Bullington Gardens
candidates.note: Co-ran the 2026 Pumpkin Patch Kids program with Henderson County 4-H, teaching gardening and plant science.

candidates.name: Henderson County Public Library
candidates.note: June–July 2026 summer reading and supervised youth events; branches also serve Etowah and Zirconia.

candidates.name: Boys & Girls Club of Henderson County
candidates.note: Summer youth programming operated in 2025 and 2026, with academic support and supervised enrichment.

candidates.name: Camp Greystone
candidates.note: Girls’ overnight camp has announced 2027 sessions; cooking classes teach kitchen skills and recipes.
